description: Insider trading data from SEC Form 4, no API key: one clean row per insider buy or sell (insider, role, open-market purchase/sale, shares, price, USD value, holdings after, 10b5-1 plan flag, filing link). Filter by ticker, insider, type, minimum value, date. Cluster-buy mode finds 3+ insiders buying the same stock within 14 days. Only-new mode alerts you once per new trade. Usable from AI agents via MCP. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/insider-trading-api.

cik.description: Or the SEC CIK number of the company (issuer), e.g. 1045810 for NVIDIA.

clusterDays.description: Clusters mode: purchases must fall within this many days.

derivatives.description: Also return derivative-table rows (options, RSUs, warrants). Default only common-stock (non-derivative) transactions.

excludePlans.description: Drop trades made under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan (scheduled sales say less than discretionary buys).

insider.description: Insider CIK (works market-wide) or a name part (needs a ticker here), e.g. 'Huang'.

minValue.description: Only transactions worth at least this many US dollars (shares x price). In clusters mode it applies to the cluster total.

mode.description: trades = one row per insider transaction (newest first); clusters = stocks where several different insiders made open-market purchases within clusterDays (needs a ticker or cik on this Apify version); latest = newest Form 4 filings across t

role.description: director, officer or ten_percent_owner (comma list). Empty = all.

since.description: Only transactions on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

sinceDays.description: Only transactions from the last N days.

ticker.description: US stock ticker(s), comma separated, e.g. 'NVDA' or 'AAPL,MSFT'. Share classes work with a dot or dash (BRK.B). Empty = whole market.

type.description: buy (open-market purchase, code P), sell (open-market sale, code S), all, or SEC codes comma separated (P,S,A,M,F,G,D,C,X,J...). Empty = all.

until.description: Only transactions on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: insider_trading_api
title: SEC Form 4 Insider Trading API - Executive Buys, Sells & Cluster Signals
